y: number } | null;\n  originalFramePos: number;\n  currentDragFrame: number | null;\n}\n\nexport function getTimelineItemAspectRatioStyle(\n  image: GenerationRow,\n  projectAspectRatio?: string,\n): CSSProperties {\n  let width = image.metadata?.width as number | undefined;\n  let height = image.metadata?.height as number | undefined;\n\n  if (!width || !height) {\n    const originalParams = image.metadata?.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;\n    const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;\n    const resolution = orchestratorDetails?.resolution as string | undefined;\n    if (resolution && resolution.includes('x')) {\n      const [w, h] = resolution.split('x').map(Number);\n      if (!Number.isNaN(w) && !Number.isNaN(h)) {\n        width = w;\n        height = h;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (width && height) {\n    return { aspectRatio: `${width / height}` };\n  }\n\n  return getProjectAspectRatioStyle(projectAspectRatio);\n}\n\nexport function getTimelineItemPosition({\n  timelineWidth,\n  fullMinFrames,\n  fullRange,\n  framePosition,\n  isDragging,\n  dragOffset,\n  originalFramePos,\n  currentDragFrame,\n}: TimelineItemPositionInput): { leftPercent: number; displayFrame: number } {\n  const effectiveWidth = timelineWidth - (TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET * 2);\n  const pixelPosition = TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET + ((framePosition - fullMinFrames) / fullRange) * effectiveWidth;\n\n  let finalX = pixelPosition;\n  if (isDragging && dragOffset) {\n    const originalPixel = TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET + ((originalFramePos - fullMinFrames) / fullRange) * effectiveWidth;\n    finalX = originalPixel + dragOffset.x;\n  }\n\n  const displayFrame = isDragging && currentDragFrame !== null ? currentDragFrame : framePosition;\n  const leftPercent = (finalX / timelineWidth) * 100;\n\n  return { leftPercent, displayFrame };\n}\nEOF"

}

  "cmd": "cat > src/shared/lib/preloading/queue.ts <<'EOF'\n/**\n * PreloadQueue\n *\n * A priority queue for image preloading that limits concurrent requests\n * to avoid overwhelming the browser.\n *\n * Features:\n * - Priority-based ordering (higher priority loads first)\n * - Concurrent request limiting\n * - Cancellation support\n * - Promise-based API\n * - Returns loaded HTMLImageElement for ref storage\n */\n\ninterface QueueItem {\n  url: string;\n  priority: number;\n  resolve: (element: HTMLImageElement) => void;\n  reject: (err: Error) => void;\n  aborted: boolean;\n}\n\nexport class PreloadQueue {\n  private queue: QueueItem[] = [];\n  private active = 0;\n  private maxConcurrent: number;\n\n  constructor(maxConcurrent = 3) {\n    this.maxConcurrent = maxConcurrent;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Update queue concurrency at runtime.\n   * Useful when preloading should run in degraded mode.\n   */\n  setMaxConcurrent(maxConcurrent: number): void {\n    this.maxConcurrent = Math.max(1, maxConcurrent);\n    void this.processNext();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Add a URL to the preload queue.\n   * Returns a promise that resolves with the loaded HTMLImageElement.\n   *\n   * @param url - The image URL to preload\n   * @param priority - Higher numbers load first (default: 0)\n   */\n  add(url: string, priority = 0): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n      const item: QueueItem = {\n        url,\n        priority,\n        resolve,\n        reject,\n        aborted: false,\n      };\n\n      // Insert sorted by priority (higher first)\n      const insertIdx = this.queue.findIndex((q) => q.priority < priority);\n      if (insertIdx === -1) {\n        this.queue.push(item);\n      } else {\n        this.queue.splice(insertIdx, 0, item);\n      }\n\n      this.processNext();\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Clear all pending items from the queue.\n   * Active loads will complete but their callbacks are ignored.\n   */\n  clear(): void {\n    this.queue.forEach((item) => {\n      item.aborted = true;\n    });\n    this.queue = [];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get the current queue size (pending items only)\n   */\n  get size(): number {\n    return this.queue.length;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get the number of currently active loads\n   */\n  get activeCount(): number {\n    return this.active;\n  }\n\n  private async processNext(): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.active >= this.maxConcurrent || this.queue.length === 0) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const item = this.queue.shift()!;\n\n    // Skip if already aborted\n    if (item.aborted) {\n      this.processNext();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.active++;\n\n    try {\n      const element = await this.loadImage(item.url);\n      if (!item.aborted) {\n        item.resolve(element);\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      if (!item.aborted) {\n        item.reject(err as Error);\n      }\n    } finally {\n      this.active--;\n      // Process next item after a microtask to avoid blocking\n      queueMicrotask(() => this.processNext());\n    }\n  }\n\n  private loadImage(url: string): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n      const img = new Image();\n\n      img.onload = () => {\n        img.onload = null;\n        img.onerror = null;\n        resolve(img);\n      };\n\n      img.onerror = () => {\n        img.onload = null;\n        img.onerror = null;\n        reject(new Error(`Failed to load image: ${url}`));\n      };\n\n      img.src = url;\n    });\n  }\n}\nEOF"
}

{
  "cmd": "cat > src/shared/hooks/invalidation/useTaskInvalidation.ts <<'EOF'\nimport { QueryClient, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';\nimport { useCallback } from 'react';\nimport { taskQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/tasks';\nimport { invalidateGenerationsSync } from './useGenerationInvalidation';\n\nexport type TaskInvalidationScope = 'list' | 'detail' | 'counts' | 'all';\n\nexport interface TaskInvalidationOptions {\n  scope?: TaskInvalidationScope;\n  reason: string;\n  taskId?: string;\n  projectId?: string;\n  includeGenerations?: boolean;\n  shotId?: string;\n}\n\nfunction invalidateTaskList(queryClient: QueryClient, projectId?: string): void {\n  if (projectId) {\n    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](projectId) });\n    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](projectId) });\n    return;\n  }\n\n  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });\n  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });\n}\n\nfunction invalidateTaskDetail(\n  queryClient: QueryClient,\n  taskId: string,\n  projectId?: string,\n): void {\n  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](taskId) });\n  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](taskId, projectId ?? null) });\n  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](taskId) });\n  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](taskId) });\n  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](taskId) });\n}\n\nfunction invalidateTaskCounts(queryClient: QueryClient, projectId?: string): void {\n  if (projectId) {\n    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](projectId) });\n    return;\n  }\n\n  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });\n}\n\nfunction performTaskInvalidation(\n  queryClient: QueryClient,\n  options: TaskInvalidationOptions,\n): void {\n  const scope = options.scope ?? 'all';\n\n  if (scope === 'all' || scope === 'list') {\n    invalidateTaskList(queryClient, options.projectId);\n  }\n\n  if ((scope === 'all' || scope === 'detail') && options.taskId) {\n    invalidateTaskDetail(queryClient, options.taskId, options.projectId);\n  }\n\n  if (scope === 'all' || scope === 'counts') {\n    invalidateTaskCounts(queryClient, options.projectId);\n  }\n\n  if (options.includeGenerations && options.shotId) {\n    invalidateGenerationsSync(queryClient, options.shotId, {\n      scope: 'all',\n      reason: options.reason,\n      projectId: options.projectId,\n      includeProjectUnified: true,\n    });\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Synchronous task invalidation helper for non-hook call sites.\n */\nexport function invalidateTasksSync(\n  queryClient: QueryClient,\n  options: TaskInvalidationOptions,\n): void {\n  performTaskInvalidation(queryClient, options);\n}\n\n/**\n * Hook wrapper around task cache invalidation.\n */\nexport function useInvalidateTasks(): (options: TaskInvalidationOptions) => void {\n  const queryClient = useQueryClient();\n\n  return useCallback((options: TaskInvalidationOptions) => {\n    performTaskInvalidation(queryClient, options);\n  }, [queryClient]);\n}\nEOF"
}

You’re right, and here’s the precise root cause.

1. `plan show` and `plan queue` are not using the same queue definition.
- `plan show` reports only `len(plan["queue_order"])` ([cmd.py:84](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/cmd.py:84), [cmd.py:102](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/cmd.py:102)).
- `plan queue`/`next` build a dynamic work queue that injects synthetic subjective items ([core.py:96](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/core.py:96), [synthetic.py:161](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/synthetic.py:161)).

2. Why subjective items appeared “after queue was cleared”:
- Objective backlog calculation explicitly excludes skipped IDs ([subjective_policy.py:103](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/subjective_policy.py:103), [subjective_policy.py:118](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/subjective_policy.py:118)).
- Skipped issues are removed before lifecycle gating ([core.py:251](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/core.py:251)).
- Then lifecycle sees “no objective items” and surfaces endgame subjective items ([core.py:297](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/core.py:297)).
- This behavior is explicitly tested as intended today ([work_queue_cases.py:948](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/tests/review/work_queue_cases.py:948), [work_queue_cases.py:1001](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/tests/review/work_queue_cases.py:1001)).

3. Why score stayed frozen:
- `status` freezes whenever `queue_remaining > 0` regardless of whether remaining items are only subjective ([cmd.py:200](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/status/cmd.py:200), [cmd.py:204](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/status/cmd.py:204)).
- So subjective-only remaining still blocks “finalized” score display there.

4. Why you didn’t get `scan` first:
- `workflow::run-scan` is only injected when queue is truly empty ([core.py:302](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/core.py:302)).
- Because subjective items were injected, queue wasn’t empty, so `run-scan` never appeared.

So your expected flow (`scan -> subjective reviews -> score -> triage`) is not what current code enforces in this skipped-objective state. Also, per docs this is inconsistent with “when queue is clear, go back to scan” ([SKILL.md:100](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/docs/SKILL.md:100)).

Yes. I traced it precisely, and the behavior is currently **by design in code/tests**, even though it conflicts with the workflow you want.

**What’s happening**
1. `plan show` says queue is 0 because it only counts `plan["queue_order"]`  
   [cmd.py:84](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/cmd.py:84)  
   [cmd.py:102](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/cmd.py:102)

2. `plan queue` / `next` do **not** just read `queue_order`; they rebuild a dynamic queue and always include subjective synthetic items (`include_subjective=True`)  
   [queue_render.py:148](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/queue_render.py:148)  
   [queue_render.py:153](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/queue_render.py:153)  
   [core.py:113](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/core.py:113)

3. Subjective synthetic items are generated for every dimension below target strict (95 by default), not only “after scan”  
   [synthetic.py:166](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/synthetic.py:166)  
   [synthetic.py:213](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/synthetic.py:213)

4. Skipped objective issues are removed from the live queue **before** lifecycle gating  
   [core.py:251](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/core.py:251)

5. Lifecycle then sees “no objective items left” and allows endgame subjective items through  
   [core.py:273](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/core.py:273)  
   [core.py:297](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/core.py:297)

6. `workflow::run-scan` appears only if queue is fully empty; subjective items prevent that fallback  
   [core.py:302](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/core.py:302)

7. This exact behavior is regression-tested: skipped objective items should allow subjective to surface  
   [work_queue_cases.py:948](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/tests/review/work_queue_cases.py:948)

8. Status freezing is also tied to `queue_total > 0` (includes subjective), so it keeps saying “won’t update until queue clear + scan”  
   [status/cmd.py:200](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/status/cmd.py:200)  
   [status/cmd.py:204](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/status/cmd.py:204)

So the mismatch is:
- `plan show` = prioritized plan order only
- `plan queue`/`next` = dynamic actionable queue (includes synthetic subjective)
- and skipped objective work is treated as “objective drained,” which triggers subjective early.

I verified two ways:

Why this happens:

- `plan show` reports queue from raw `queue_order` only ([cmd.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/cmd.py:84)).
- `next/plan queue` build synthetic subjective items from score state even when `queue_order` is empty ([core.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/core.py:113)).
- scan preflight gates on `breakdown.actionable` ([preflight.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/scan/preflight.py:64)), and `actionable` excludes only workflow, not subjective ([queue_progress.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/helpers/queue_progress.py:43)).

So local state is a trigger condition (active cycle + subjective below target), but the mismatch itself is a code-path logic issue, not state corruption.

can you share info on the bug for me to fix?

> AGENT

Yes. Here’s a precise bug packet you can use to fix it.

**Repro (logic-level, not local-state-specific)**
1. Build a state with only under-target/stale subjective dimensions and no objective issues.
2. Use a plan with `plan_start_scores.strict` set and `queue_order=[]`.
3. `build_work_queue(...)` returns subjective items.
4. `plan_aware_queue_breakdown(...)` returns:
`objective_actionable=0`, `actionable>0`.
5. Scan preflight blocks because it gates on `actionable`, not `objective_actionable`.

I confirmed this with an isolated synthetic in-memory state (no `.desloppify` files).

**Root cause**
1. `plan show` uses only raw `queue_order` length, so it can print `0` even when synthetic subjective items exist in the actual work queue.
[cmd.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/cmd.py:84)
2. `build_work_queue` injects subjective items from score state independently of `queue_order`.
[core.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/core.py:113)
3. Lifecycle filtering allows those subjective items when objective items are gone.
[core.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/core.py:290)
4. Scan preflight blocks on `breakdown.actionable` (counts subjective), so scan is blocked even when objective queue is complete.
[preflight.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/scan/preflight.py:64)
5. `actionable` excludes only workflow, not subjective.
[queue_progress.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/helpers/queue_progress.py:43)
6. Since scan is blocked, post-scan cycle-finalization logic that would clear plan-start state never runs.
[plan_reconcile.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/scan/plan_reconcile.py:124)

**Fix direction**
1. Change scan preflight gate to `breakdown.objective_actionable > 0` (not `actionable > 0`).
2. Make `plan show` queue line use the same queue source as `next/plan queue` (or print both raw planned and dynamic queue counts clearly).
3. If you want strict phase ordering (`scan -> subjective reviews -> score -> triage`), hide endgame subjective synthetic items before scan and show `workflow::run-scan` first once objective queue is drained.

**Tests to add**
1. Objective drained + subjective remaining + active plan-start score:
scan preflight should allow scan.
2. `plan show` vs `plan queue` count consistency when only synthetic subjective items remain.
3. End-of-objective flow should surface `workflow::run-scan` before subjective re-review items (if that’s your intended workflow).

**Ordering bug (the one you care about)**
It appears in runs where review/concerns churn is detected. The code path can inject triage before your intended sequence because:

1. Post-scan reconcile runs triage sync before score/create-plan sync:  
[plan_reconcile.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/scan/plan_reconcile.py:326), then [plan_reconcile.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/scan/plan_reconcile.py:328), [plan_reconcile.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/scan/plan_reconcile.py:330)

2. Triage stages are inserted at the front of planned flow:  
[stale_dimensions.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/stale_dimensions.py:216)

3. Queue ranking gives triage stages higher priority than workflow actions:  
[ranking.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/ranking.py:43), [ranking.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/ranking.py:197), [ranking.py](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/ranking.py:204)
